title: SQUALITY: Building a Long-Document Summarization Dataset the Hard Way
reasoning: The paper's focus is on creating a benchmark dataset for long-document summarization. It includes a standard 'Ethical Considerations' section that discusses potential harms from the source texts (sci-fi stories from 1930-1970) and the responsible use of the dataset. However, it does not involve the evaluation or benchmarking of religion, morals, or ethics as part of its core research contribution.
